...No Jesus, No peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...

“The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life.” —John 6:63

...Thru the Bible - Questions & Answers  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

1) Could you explain Ezekiel 36:24-25 in regards to the current return of Israel as a fulfillment of prophecy?

2) When will God create the new heaven and earth mentioned in Isaiah 65:17, and how will the former things never come to mind?

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-questions-and-answers/?ref=sc

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

Open my eyes

“Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures.” There are things that are above human comprehension, and only the Spirit of God can make these things real to us. And our prayer ought to be, “Open Thou mine eyes that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy Word.” We need to bring a humble mind to the study of the Word of God. Just because you read it in the Bible, does not mean you know it. The Spirit of God will have to make it real to you. If you bring to the Bible an honest heart and you sincerely want to know God’s truth, if you have doubts, then bring them to Him.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/open-my-eyes-1293563.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

As far as the east is from the west, [so] far hath he removed our transgressions from us. (Psalm 103:12)

God's forgiveness is immeasurable! Though we be drowned in sin-though we be true sons of Adam steeped in iniquity-God will ever draw His people into His fold and cleanse them from the death-stain of their corruption. Rest in the Lord's forgiveness and go forth in new righteousness!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Not another wake-up alarm...

And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown. -- Jonah 3:4

God sends warnings into our lives to help us. Each time, they are given for a specific purpose that requires action.

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/not-another-wake-up-alarm



...C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (September 19th)...

"For this child I prayed." — 1 Samuel 1:27

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

...C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (September 20th)...

"The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon." — Judges 7:20

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=264

...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm

“The sin underneath all our sins is to trust the lie of the serpent that we cannot trust the love and grace of Christ and must take matters into our own hands” - Martin Luther
